targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("TREAT_GEN_WARNING_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS treatment_general_warning_alarm,
  LAST_VALUE(("SEWAGE_TREATMENT_PLANT_GENERAL_ALARM").value ORDER BY time) AS treatment_general_alarm
FROM marpower."340000_sewage"

SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('TREAT_GEN_WARNING_ALARM') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)              AS treatment_general_warning_alarm_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('SEWAGE_TREATMENT_PLANT_GENERAL_ALARM') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS treatment_general_alarm_tag
FROM marpower.io_metadata_marpower
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage'
